annotations.title: Read the fields of a job’s application form

description: Use this when the user wants to apply for a job (Bewerbung) from get_job_matches or list_saved_jobs through the employer’s form. `lesung.felder` lists its fields: `aus_cv` (from the resume), `offen` (shown as a form with MCP Apps; else ask all at once, numbered; decide what is left) and `nur_pro` (consents and personal characteristics: only the user sets them; never answer them or call them done). With `hintergrundlesung` the app or browser extension reads it in the background: wait `wiederFragenIn` seconds, call again, give no link yet. Without `lesung`, give `leselink` (the app or browser extension reads it and returns to the chat) or else `link`, then call again. `link` opens the filled form to submit: give it only at the end. If `hinweis` is set, show it and get the user’s OK before the first answer; never confirm it yourself. Scope: cv:lesen.
name: get_form_fields
title: Read the fields of a job’s application form
